title: Using ChatGPT for Job Applications | Supercharge Your Job Search with AI
description:
If you're thinking of using ChatGPT for job applications, you're not alone. More and more candidates are leveraging AI to help tailor their resumes, write custom cover letters, and prep for interviews. 

Here's how ChatGPT can help you put your best foot forward as you job search.

00:00 Introduction
00:26 Reminder to edit your ChatGPT results
00:51 Use ChatGPT to tailor your resume to a job description
01:38 What does it mean to "tailor your resume"?
03:36 Use ChatGPT to write a tailored cover letter
05:26 Write a follow-up email with ChatGPT
07:04 Update your LinkedIn profile using ChatGPT
07:38 Conclusion

 Note: You'll want to edit these after AI takes the first pass. The tech is there to help and support you, but we don't encourage using it as a substitute for doing the work entirely.
